Outer decorators survive disposal and cannot reactivate a disposed terminal AgX hook
Failed partial installation restores earlier materials without disposing model resources
AgX retains increasing highlight distinctions that unmapped sRGB output clips to white; exposure remains one
checks.method: CPU evaluation of the installed Three AgX equations for neutral radiance, not a measured framebuffer result

existingLightAnalysis.explanation: Native PBR can produce radiance above 1 from existing lights and RoomEnvironment reflections. NoToneMapping only applies sRGB conversion and clips that range in display. Local AgX compresses that radiance without reducing lights or exposure.

limitations: CPU shader composition and real GLB material preservation only; webpage WebGL compilation and visual acceptance are still pending.
